overview.en:
Skill for reading Hacker News from chat — top / new / best stories plus thread fetches via the public Firebase API.

Browse public Hacker News stories and discussions. Keep story links and distinguish a submitted claim from comments about it.

Use this plugin in a Ghast conversation with the relevant inputs or project context. The bundled workflow guides the task; any required external tools or runtime must be available in your environment.
overview.zh-CN:
读取 Hacker News 热门、最新与精选内容以及讨论串。

浏览公开 Hacker News 文章与讨论，保留文章链接，并区分投稿中的说法与评论观点。

在 Ghast 对话中提供相关输入或项目背景后使用本插件。随附流程会指导任务；所需外部工具或运行环境仍需在本机可用。

starterPrompts.en: Summarize the current top Hacker News stories.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 汇总当前 Hacker News 热门文章。

starterPrompts.en: Read this discussion and summarize the main viewpoints.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 阅读这段讨论，汇总主要观点。

starterPrompts.en: Compare the available recent stories on this technology topic.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 比较近期可用的这个技术主题相关文章。
